Title: GA OData API type in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
We're thrilled to announce the general availability of the OData API type in Azure API Management. This exciting addition extends Azure API Management's capabilities to include OData APIs, allowing users to apply standard API protections such as authentication, authorization, and rate limiting, alongside OData-specific policies for request validation. With first-class support for OData, it's now easier for customers to leverage Azure API Management for publishing APIs from platforms like SAP, Oracle, Dataverse, and others that expose OData APIs.

To learn more about the OData API type and its capabilities, please visit our documentation at https://aka.ms/apim/odata/odata-docs.
